{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Petal Gas Storage Extension Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Petal storage header, Forrest County, Mississippi to near Enterprise, Clarke County (Southern Natural Gas and Destin Pipeline interconnects), Mississippi.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2001/02/05/01-2921/petal-gas-storage-llc-notice-of-application|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Petal Gas Storage LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2001/02/05/01-2921/petal-gas-storage-llc-notice-of-application|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''680 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''58.7 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2001/02/05/01-2921/petal-gas-storage-llc-notice-of-application|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''36 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2001/02/05/01-2921/petal-gas-storage-llc-notice-of-application|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2001<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2001/02/05/01-2921/petal-gas-storage-llc-notice-of-application|title=federalregister.gov|website=federalregister.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$94,300,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
